CheckTitle: Account-level default Workers usage model should be Standard
Description: Checks the account-level default Workers usage model. When set to 'bundled', newly deployed scripts inherit legacy resource limits unless explicitly overridden, which can introduce security and reliability risks silently.
Risk: If the account default is 'bundled', developers who deploy new Workers without specifying a usage model will silently get the legacy model with lower CPU limits and weaker isolation.

Code.Other: Cloudflare Dashboard > Workers & Pages > Account Settings > Default Usage Model > Standard

Recommendation.Text: Set the account-level default Workers usage model to 'Standard' to ensure all new Workers inherit safe defaults.
